newsitem.title: USA: Consolidated says unit settles dispute.
newsitem.headline: Consolidated says unit settles dispute.

text.p: Consolidated Technology Group Ltd said on Friday that its subsidiary SIS Capital Corp had entered into a settlement agreement over a dispute with Lafayette Industries Inc.
The settlement pertains to the Dec. 20 sale of all the shares of SES Holdings Inc by SIS to Lafayette, Consolidated said in a statement.

Later, when Lafayette accountants were unable to certify Lafayette's financial statement for its year ended Dec. 31, 1996, Lafayette and SIS agreed that Lafayette would transfer its interest in SESH back to a SIS subsidiary.
They also agreed that SIS, in return, would transfer back to Lafayette all of the Lafayette capital stock received under the agreement.
The settlement was consummated on April 21, the company said.
